d:
First of all, this is a colored version of Kyuume's translation. Without their great work on this, there's a good chance that I'd never have read this comic to begin with. So Kyuume, if you're reading this, thank you!

This is my first time coloring a manga and it was all done by hand, meaning I used no AI. It did take a while, but I'm much happier with it than I would have been otherwise! I'll probably color more of this series, but I might take a brief detour before then.
